planSteps.description: Navigate to /, scroll 'hero-demo' into view, wait until 'demo-play' is enabled
Click 'demo-play' to pause, then click 'demo-restart' once so the demo is paused at round 1 (restart keeps a paused demo paused)
Click on the 'hero-demo' frame background (not a button) to focus it and press the ArrowRight key
Press ArrowRight, then press the R key
